ai_summary: Ashiana Housing reported a subdued Q1 FY27 with significantly lower revenue and PAT primarily due to project handover timing, yet maintained robust collections and healthy operating cash generation. The company is strategically pivoting towards the high-growth Senior Living segment with a major land acquisition, which will drive long-term value despite potential moderation in overall near-term presales growth. While residential demand softened, management remains confident in its FY27 presales target of INR 2,200 crores and aims for a sustainable 15%+ Return on Equity.
